items.informal_name: Product Degrees Inequality in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_3} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R},
  (∏ i ∈ s, f i).degrees ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).degrees
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of indices and a family of multivariate polynomials $ f_i $ over $ \sigma $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, the multiset of variables in the product $ \prod_{i \in s} f_i $ is less than or equal to the sum of the variable multisets of each $ f_i $. This partial order denotes submultiset inclusion, meaning every variable in the product's multiset appears with multiplicity no greater than its total multiplicity in the summed multisets.

items.informal_name: Total Degree of Product of Multivariate Polynomials is at Most Sum of Total Degrees
items.type:

  (s.prod f).totalDegree ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).totalDegree
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of indices and any function $ f $ assigning a multivariate polynomial $ f(i) $ in variables $ \sigma $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ to each index $ i \in s $, the total degree of the product $ \prod_{i \in s} f(i) $ is less than or equal to the sum $ \sum_{i \in s} \deg(f(i)) $, where $ \deg(f(i)) $ denotes the total degree of $ f(i) $.

items.informal_name: Total Degree of Multiset Product of Multivariate Polynomials is Bounded by Sum of Degrees
items.type:

  s.prod.totalDegree ≤ (Multiset.map MvPolynomial.totalDegree s).sum
items.informal_description: For any multiset $ s $ of multivariate polynomials over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, the total degree of the product of all elements in $ s $ is less than or equal to the sum of the total degrees of the individual polynomials in $ s $. Formally, $ \deg\left(\prod_{p \in s} p\right) \leq \sum_{p \in s} \deg(p) $, where $ \deg $ denotes the total degree.

items.informal_name: Schwartz-Zippel Lemma: Root Bound via Supremum of Exponent Ratios
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        p.support.sup fun s => ∑ i, ↑(s i) / ↑(S i).card
items.informal_description: For any non-zero multivariate polynomial $ p $ in $ n $ variables over a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any finite subsets $ S_i \subseteq R $ for each variable, the ratio of the number of roots of $ p $ in the product set $ S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n $ to the product of the cardinalities $ \prod_{i=1}^n |S_i| $ is at most the supremum over all monomials $ s $ in the support of $ p $ of the sum $ \sum_{i=1}^n \frac{s_i}{|S_i|} $, where $ s_i $ denotes the exponent of the $ i $-th variable in the monomial $ s $. All divisions are performed in the non-negative rational numbers $ \mathbb{Q}_{\geq 0} $.

items.informal_name: Schwartz-Zippel Inequality for Multivariate Polynomials with Sum of Degrees
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        ∑ i, ↑(MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p) / ↑(S i).card
items.informal_description: For a non-zero multivariate polynomial $ p $ in $ n $ variables over a commutative semiring $ R $, and finite sets $ S_i \subseteq R $ for each variable $ i $, the ratio of the number of roots of $ p $ in the Cartesian product $ S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n $ to the product of the sizes $ \prod_{i=1}^n |S_i| $ is at most the sum of the degrees of $ p $ in each variable divided by the corresponding $ |S_i| $. Formally, $$\frac{\#\{x \in S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n \mid p(x) = 0\}}{\prod_{i=1}^n |S_i|} \leq \sum_{i=1}^n \frac{\deg_i(p)}{|S_i|},$$ where $ \deg_i(p) $ denotes the total degree of $ p $ in variable $ i $.

items.informal_name: Natural Degree of Polynomial Product Inequality: $\operatorname{nat-degree}(\prod_{i \in s} f(i)) \leq \sum_{i \in s} \operatorname{nat-degree}(f(i))$
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : ι → Polynomial R),
  (∏ i ∈ s, f i).natDegree ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natDegree
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, and for any finite set $ s $ and function $ f : s \to R[X] $, the natural degree of the product of the polynomials $ f(i) $ for $ i \in s $ is less than or equal to the sum of the natural degrees of each $ f(i) $. Symbolically, $ \operatorname{nat-degree}\left( \prod_{i \in s} f(i) \right) \leq \sum_{i \in s} \operatorname{nat-degree}(f(i)) $.
